messages:
Priya (SI Lead): Hey team — we have a new cohort of 8 SI partners starting next month. I want to run a virtual "Shadow Day" to walk them through marketplace onboarding, hardware partner touchpoints, and our cert badging flow. Dates: Mon Apr 18 or Wed Apr 20. Who can co-host?
Ethan (Partnerships): I can do Apr 18 in the morning (PST). Happy to cover marketplace listing requirements and the partner checklist.
Lina (Learning): I can take the cert badging + hands-on lab walkthrough. Can we keep it under 90 mins? We should leave time for Qs.
Jared (Solutions): I'll join for the hardware integration Q&A — can demo a short runbook for GPU quota requests. Need a 10-min slot.
Carmen (Sales): I can join the first 30 mins to overview GTM / partner-facing collateral and co-sell enablement.
Priya (SI Lead): Awesome. Plan: 90min total -> 10m intro, 20m marketplace, 20m certs/labs, 15m hw integration, 15m QA + next steps. Lina can you own lab invites?
Lina (Learning): Yep. I need a list of SI email domains to pre-provision lab access. Also: do we want prework? Suggest 20-min prework (quick self-checklist + sandbox access).
Ethan (Partnerships): I'll share the partner list by EOD. Also flag: some SIs will need Marketplace dev accounts in AWS/GCP — we should call out cloud marketplace timelines.
Jared (Solutions): For the GPU quota, can we add this snippet to the runbook?
calendar-bot: Poll created: "Shadow Day — Apr 18 vs Apr 20" (link: https://cal.poll/abc123)
Priya (SI Lead): Addendum: we want a "shadow" pairing — an experienced SI shadowing each new SI during onboarding. Volunteers?
Carmen (Sales): I can shadow 2 SIs (EMEA).
Ethan (Partnerships): I'll take NA.
Lina (Learning): I'll coordinate shadow schedules and the certification intake form (short form link).
Priya (SI Lead): Logistics checklist draft (quick):
```
- Create calendar invite + Zoom + recording
- Prework + sandbox provisioning (Lina)
- Marketplace listing checklist (Ethan)
- HW integration runbook + quota form (Jared)
- Cert badging criteria + assessment link (Lina)
- Co-hosts & shadow pairings (Priya)
- Follow-up: 1:1 onboarding slots (Carmen)
```
Jared (Solutions): Need a note about private deployments — some SIs will ask about on-prem packages and KMS/HSM support. Add to Q&A.
Priya (SI Lead): Good call. Also want to surface our rollout policies and canary strategies for Dedicated customers.
Ethan (Partnerships): For marketplace approvals, remind partners about SLA docs and test instances. I'll attach the submission template.
Lina (Learning): Can someone share the training repo link and the lab token generation command? I will bake it into the invite.
Jared (Solutions): repo: https://git.company/si-onboarding. Token command: `./scripts/mint-lab-token --email partner@domain.com --expires 7d`
Priya (SI Lead): Perfect. Last Q: recording distribution policy? We should restrict recordings to partner attendees only. Any objections?
Carmen (Sales): No objections. Keep to partner list + internal hosts.
Ethan (Partnerships): Agreed. Also recommend a follow-up feedback survey (2-3 questions) to catch blockers.
Priya (SI Lead): Cool — I'll schedule Apr 18 10:00-11:30 PST and send poll link. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
